title: Towards Fairer Health Recommendations: finding informative unbiased samples via Word Sense Disambiguation

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering ambiguous keywords (e.g., 'white') using Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) to construct reliable negative samples, followed by evaluating fine-tuned language models and prompted LLMs for binary bias classification on annotated medical curriculum excerpts.
Evaluating fine-tuned language models (e.g., RoBERTa, TinyLlama) and prompted LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o mini) for binary bias classification on a dataset of medical curriculum excerpts annotated by experts.
